description:
## Problem (observed by a reviewer and the contract-test author reading code and running fakes; not run against a real ClickHouse Cloud service)
`check_server_database_exists` calls `_create_admin_client`, which reads `self.send_receive_timeout`. The ClickHouse Cloud adapter never sets that attribute, so the call raises `AttributeError`, which is swallowed and reported as "no database". Consequences: `--force-recreate` never recreates anything on ClickHouse Cloud, and a real drop would fail for the same reason.

## Change
- Set (or default) the timeout on the Cloud adapter, or have `_create_admin_client` not depend on it.
- Do not swallow `AttributeError` into "no database": surface a real error.
- Add the Cloud case to the mid-run contract test with a driver fake that exercises the probe.

## Guardrails (must preserve)
- No live cloud runs without explicit approval stating the command, maximum runtime, log path and stop condition.

## Process guardrails
- One PR per item against `develop`, via the AGENTS.md worktree flow.
- Verification ladder: `uv run -- python -m pytest -m fast -q`, `uv run -- ruff check .`, `uv run -- ruff format --check .` and `uv run -- ty check`; then `make pr-preflight` and `make pr-open`.
- Stage explicit paths; never `git add -A`. Re-read every anchor before editing.
